evidence:

No other port literal anywhere in tests/ (regex sweep).

DRIFTS REPORTED (Note level, both locations given):
(1) Role vocabulary: instruction.md:19 calls the approvers '(Approver, Band I)', '(Approver, Band II)', '(Approver, Band III)'; app_context.md:12-14 calls the same accounts 'Approver, tier 1/2/3', as do the seed (authority_tier) and the criteria. hireops_rules.md:41-42 and 164-165 ('A tier-3 (Band III) approver') bridge the two, so the mapping is not contradictory, but the brief's label is the offer-band word the rules themselves call confusing.
(2) Screen names: instruction.md:5 lists 'Equity' and 'Audit' views; app_context.md:20 lists 'Equity Table' and 'Audit Trail' and hro_anon_read_equity says 'Equity Table'. Mitigated by instruction.md:5 'the layout and names are yours' and app_context.md:28-29 'suitable labels'.
(3) /assets at runtime: instruction.md:17 says '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime', while task.toml:2 carries /assets as an artifact and test.sh:88 chmods it, and integration.md:6-7 says 'Starting records are in /assets/seed_data.json'. The brief is stricter than the harness; a submission following it (copy the seed into /app, as the golden does) and one reading /assets directly both work, so nothing is graded wrongly.
(4) Wait tolerance: functional prompt.md:77 'press Tab and allow up to3 seconds' versus hro_desk_figures 'allow a few seconds'. Compatible but not the same words.
Also noted, shared template file so not a task edit: restart_mcp.py:18-19 says 'call it only for the persistence criterion' (singular) while two rows (hro_restart, hro_change_retry_restart) read the one restart; functional prompt P10 and B6 reconcile this ('Reuse the one real restart in P10').

RUN EVIDENCE: raw-evidence-index.json hashes all verify against current bytes. results/server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice (start and restart) and live-desk.json reports the restart/persistence and live-update steps passing with arrival_ms 807 - this corroborates port, entry, DB persistence and the 15-second figure for the golden under uid 65534. It is a scripted golden run, not a configured judge run: RewardKit's expansion of $APP_RESTART_HELPER, {app_context} substitution into the prompts and the judge's use of restart_app were not executed for this candidate, so the consumption side of those agreements rests on source reading only. That is why risk is true.
